title: Complex-Valued Functions on Finite Tuples
statement: For a type $G$ and a natural number $n$, let $\ell^2(G^n;\mathbb{C})$ denote the space of complex-valued functions on $n$-tuples of elements of $G$, namely the functions $(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to G)\to\mathbb{C}$.
